title: Autumnal Sweetcorn Hash
description: A hearty breakfast dish combining roasted autumnal ingredients with a crispy sweetcorn hash.
instructions: Toss sweet potatoes and apples with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes.
Cook Canadian bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy. Set aside.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the same pan. Cook frozen sweetcorn until thawed and lightly browned.
Mix cooked sweetcorn with cooked Canadian bacon and diced hash browns.
Divide the roasted sweet potatoes and apples among four plates. Top each plate with the sweetcorn mixture.
